privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Demo Café ("Demo Café," "we," "us," or "our"), available at <1>demo.example.com</1>, collects, uses, stores, shares, and protects information when you visit our website or use our online ordering service (the "Service"), including information obtained through Sign in with Google.

section1.title: 1. Information We Collect
section1.intro: We collect the following categories of information:
section1.direct1: Delivery address and phone number, so we can fulfill and coordinate delivery of your order
section1.direct2: Order history and preferences, such as items ordered, order frequency, and saved favorites
section1.googleHeading: Information from Sign in with Google:
section1.googleIntro: If you choose to create an account or log in using "Sign in with Google," we receive the following information from your Google account, which you authorize Google to share with us during that sign-in process:
section1.google3: Your profile picture (if available on your Google account)
section1.googleNote: We do not receive your Google account password, and we do not access any other Google account data beyond what is listed above.
section1.autoNote: We do not currently use cookies or analytics tools on the Service. If we introduce analytics or similar technologies in the future (for example, to understand site usage), we will update this Privacy Policy before doing so and will only use such tools to operate, maintain, and improve the Service.

section2.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
section2.intro: We use the information described above solely to provide, maintain, and improve the Service, specifically to:
section2.item1: Create and manage your Demo Café account
section2.item2: Authenticate you when you sign in, including via Sign in with Google
section2.item3: Process, prepare, and deliver your orders
section2.item4: Communicate with you about your account or orders (for example, order confirmations or delivery updates)
section2.item5: Remember your order history and preferences to improve your experience
section2.item6: Maintain the security and proper functioning of the Service
section2.note: We do not use Google user data for serving advertisements, for determining creditworthiness or lending purposes, for building user profiles for marketing, for training or improving artificial intelligence or machine-learning models, or for any purpose unrelated to operating and improving the Service.

section3.title: 3. How We Share Your Information
section3.noSell: We do not sell your personal information or your Google user data to any third party, ever.
section3.intro: We do not transfer or disclose your information to third parties for purposes other than operating and fulfilling the Service. We may share limited information with trusted service providers who perform services on our behalf and are contractually obligated to protect your information and use it only for the purpose we've engaged them for, such as:
section3.item1: Payment processors, if and when online payment is enabled, solely to process transactions
section3.item2: Delivery or fulfillment partners, solely to complete your order
section3.item3: Hosting and infrastructure providers that store or process data on our behalf
section3.note: We may also disclose information if required to do so by law, or to protect the rights, property, or safety of Demo Café, our users, or others.

section4.title: 4. Data Retention and Deletion
section4.para1: We retain your personal information, including information obtained through Sign in with Google, for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide you the Service. We will retain and use your information as necessary to comply with our legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements, after which it will be deleted or de-identified.
section4.para2: You may request deletion of your account and associated personal information at any time by contacting us at the email address below. We will delete your information within a reasonable time, except where we are required to retain certain records by law.

section5.title: 5. How We Protect Your Information
section5.para1: We use reasonable administrative, technical, and physical safeguards designed to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or destruction, including encryption of data in transit and access controls limiting who at Demo Café can view your information. No method of transmission or storage is 100% secure, but we work to maintain appropriate safeguards for the information we hold.

section6.title: 6. Children's Privacy
section6.para1: The Service is not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If we become aware that we have collected such information, we will delete it promptly.

section7.title: 7. Your Choices
section7.para1: You may revoke Demo Café access to your Google account data at any time through your <1>Google Account security settings</1>. You may also request to access, correct, or delete the personal information we hold about you by contacting us below.

section8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
section8.para1: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. If we make material changes, particularly to how we use Google user data, we will notify users by posting the updated policy on this page with a new effective date, and where appropriate, through the Service directly.

section9.title: 9. Contact Us
section9.intro: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or wish to request access to or deletion of your data, contact us at:
